sentences.text: A glacier -LRB- -LSB- pronˈɡleɪʃər -RSB- or -LSB- ˈɡlæsiə -RSB- -RRB- is a persistent body of dense ice that is constantly moving under its own weight ; it forms where the accumulation of snow exceeds its ablation -LRB- melting and sublimation -RRB- over many years , often centuries .	ice	ice	snow	snow	ablation	ablation	sublimation	sublimation (phase transition)	centuries	Century
Glaciers slowly deform and flow due to stresses induced by their weight , creating crevasses , seracs , and other distinguishing features .
They also abrade rock and debris from their substrate to create landforms such as cirques and moraines .
Glaciers form only on land and are distinct from the much thinner sea ice and lake ice that form on the surface of bodies of water .	ice	ice	sea ice	sea ice

On Earth , 99 % of glacial ice is contained within vast ice sheets in the polar regions , but glaciers may be found in mountain ranges on every continent except Australia , and on a few high-latitude oceanic islands .	ice	ice	Earth	Earth	continent	continent	Australia	Australia

Between 35 ° N and 35 ° S , glaciers occur only in the Himalayas , Andes , Rocky Mountains , a few high mountains in East Africa , Mexico , New Guinea and on Zard Kuh in Iran .	Himalayas	Himalayas	Andes	Andes	Rocky Mountains	Rocky Mountains	East Africa	East Africa	Mexico	Mexico	New Guinea	New Guinea	Zard Kuh	Zard Kuh
Glaciers cover about 10 percent of Earth 's land surface .	Earth	Earth

Continental glaciers cover nearly 5 e6sqmi or about 98 percent of Antarctica 's 5.1 e6sqmi , with an average thickness of 7,000 ft. Greenland and Patagonia also have huge expanses of continental glaciers .	Greenland	Greenland	Patagonia	Patagonia
Glacial ice is the largest reservoir of fresh water on Earth .	ice	ice	Earth	Earth	fresh water	fresh water

Many glaciers from temperate , alpine and seasonal polar climates store water as ice during the colder seasons and release it later in the form of meltwater as warmer summer temperatures cause the glacier to melt , creating a water source that is especially important for plants , animals and human uses when other sources may be scant .	ice	ice	meltwater	meltwater	water source	Water resources
Within high altitude and Antarctic environments , the seasonal temperature difference is often not sufficient to release meltwater .	meltwater	meltwater

Because glacial mass is affected by long-term climatic changes , e.g. , precipitation , mean temperature , and cloud cover , glacial mass changes are considered among the most sensitive indicators of climate change and are a major source of variations in sea level .	climatic	climate	precipitation	precipitation (meteorology)	mean temperature	temperature	cloud cover	cloud cover	climate change	climate change	sea level	Current sea level rise
A large piece of compressed ice , or a glacier , appears blue as large quantities of water appear blue .	ice	ice	appears blue	Blue ice (glacial)	water appear blue	Color of water
This is because water molecules absorb other colors more efficiently than blue .
The other reason for the blue color of glaciers is the lack of air bubbles .
Air bubbles , which give a white color to ice , are squeezed out by pressure increasing the density of the created ice .	ice	ice
